_note: The contradiction catalogue (contradiction-danger-spec §1-2). Contradiction is NEVER computed from opposed magnitudes — it fires only from these named entries. That is the whole safety mechanism: a sunny snowy world is real worldbuilding, not a contradiction, and nothing here fires on it. Every entry is authored, testable, and nameable in the preview. All values PLACEHOLDER.

contradictions.name: A sun that does not warm
contradictions.blurb: Light of that intensity carries heat. You have written it away.

contradictions.name: Cold fire
contradictions.blurb: Molten rock that gives off no heat.

contradictions.name: Ice that does not chill
contradictions.blurb: It is frozen, and it takes nothing from the air around it.

contradictions.name: Rain that does not wet
contradictions.blurb: It falls, and the ground stays dry.

contradictions.name: A forest that casts no shade
contradictions.blurb: The canopy is closed and the light reaches the floor anyway.

contradictions.name: A sea that does not temper
contradictions.blurb: That much water, and the nights still turn bitter.

contradictions.name: Green in the dark
contradictions.blurb: Growing things that photosynthesise, in a world with nothing to photosynthesise by.

contradictions.name: Rain without air
contradictions.blurb: Moisture held aloft by an atmosphere too thin to hold it.

contradictions.name: A day that never turns
contradictions.blurb: Suns and moons in the sky, and a world that will not rotate beneath them.
